message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your warm message and your clear wish to build a long-term partnership. We share that goal, and for it to work, quality and delivery need to be on a firm footing.

Our records show where we stand today:

Your on-time delivery was 63.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

On that basis, here is what we can offer:

Our proposal: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 43.05.

This proposal sets out a clear quality standard, and it gives you a dependable basis for steady call-offs. From our side, invoices are paid reliably and on time. We look forward to your response.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.

I'll accept your 500 EUR chargeback to show we're serious, but in return we have to set the ppm to 1500. So our Angebot is a price of €47.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €47.50 per unit. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. With overtime we can deliver in 56 days, at a premium.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current proposal includes a price of €47.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis

move.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your reply and for your openness about wanting a long-term partnership. We share that aim.

We have heard your request for faster payment. Our proposal keeps the payment terms as they are, and we will not promise more than it contains. What we can offer is that every invoice is paid punctually as agreed, with steady call-offs your shop can plan around.

Quality and chargeback are agreed between us. On price, we stand by our offer:

Our proposal: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 500.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 45.50.

We believe this is a fair basis to close and look forward to your confirmation.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

Thanks for the new offer, but we really need faster payment to help with our cash situation. We want to build a long-term partnership, but we can't drop the price without better payment terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Since you are keeping the payment terms as they are, we have to stick to a price of €47.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, and a chargeback of €500.00 per complaint. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
